about: What the game answers itself, before a model is asked (Docs/Design/28-ai-cost.md). Patterns match the whole of a short, normalised utterance (lower case, contractions spelt out, punctuation gone, the NPC's name and 'please' left out). The first intent that matches wins; nothing matches, and a model answers. Patterns and tones only: what is said back is the talk library's (Data/Talk/rules/player.talk, doc 62), concept player.<intent>; the greeting's 'famous' and 'famous_look' meetings (doc 56) are tried at most once a game day a pair, 'returning' (doc 56, 10) for a wolf back after three real days or more; the 'trouble' intent (doc 57, 3) is answered with a resident's own trouble only to a wolf it trusts.
